**1 — Scene:** A mixed salad with cucumber, dark olives, shaved hard cheese, leafy greens and a few bread-like pieces.

**2 — Vessel:** A shallow oval serving plate, approximately 28 × 24 cm; equivalent circular diameter about **26 cm**. Estimated area: **3.14 × 13² = 531 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Mixed lettuce, cucumber slices, dark olives, Parmesan-style cheese shavings, a few likely croutons, and a light oily sheen. The bread-piece identification and dressing quantity are uncertain.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy:** Footprints are allocated between ingredients to avoid counting overlapping areas twice.

| Item | Vessel area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |

| Cucumber | 27% | 143 cm² × 1.6 cm = 229 ml | 0.65 | 149 g | 15 | 22 kcal |
| Dark olives | 14% | 74 cm² × 1.3 cm = 96 ml | 0.65 | 63 g | 145 | 91 kcal |
| Shaved hard cheese | 16% | 85 cm² × 0.55 cm = 47 ml | 0.95 | 44 g | 400 | 176 kcal |
| Likely croutons | 4% | 21 cm² × 2 cm = 42 ml | 0.30 | 13 g | 400 | 52 kcal |

Food footprints total **85%** of the plate, consistent with the visible coverage. The light oil coating adds no separate footprint; estimating roughly **4 ml × 1.0 = 4 g**, at **880 kcal/100 g**, adds **35 kcal**.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **311 g and 384 kcal** is plausible for this substantial but loosely piled salad. Cheese, olives and oil supply most of the energy.
